#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

const long long MOD = 998244353;

using namespace std;

static class FFT {
public:
    static const int maxk = 21;
    static const int maxn = (1 << maxk) + 1;
    static vector<double> wR, wI, rR, rI, aR, aI;
    static int n, k, lastk;
    static vector<int> dp;

    static void initialize(int current_k) {
        if (lastk != current_k) {
            lastk = current_k;
            n = 1 << current_k;
            dp.resize(n);
            for (int i = 1, g = -1; i < n; i++) {
                if ((i & (i - 1)) == 0) g++;
                dp[i] = dp[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (current_k - 1 - g));
            }
            wR.resize(n);
            wI.resize(n);
            aR.resize(n);
            aI.resize(n);
            // Initialize roots for FFT
            wR[1] = 1.0; wI[1] = 0.0;
            for (int t = 0; t < current_k - 1; t++) {
                double a = M_PI / n * (1 << (current_k - 1 - t));
                double curR = cos(a);
                double curI = sin(a);
                int p2 = 1 << t, p3 = p2 * 2;
                for (int j = p2, k = j * 2; j < p3; j++, k += 2) {
                    wR[k] = wR[j];
                    wI[k] = wI[j];
                    wR[k + 1] = wR[j] * curR - wI[j] * curI;
                    wI[k + 1] = wR[j] * curI + wI[j] * curR;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void fft(bool inv, int length) {
        int local_n = length;
        initialize((int)log2(local_n));
        for (int i = 0; i < local_n; i++) {
            int d = dp[i];
            if (i < d) {
                swap(aR[i], aR[d]);
                swap(aI[i], aI[d]);
            }
        }
        if (inv) {
            for (int i = 0; i < local_n; i++) {
                aI[i] = -aI[i];
            }
        }
        for (int len = 1; len < local_n; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < local_n; i += len << 1) {
                int wit = len;
                for (int j = i, j2 = i + len; j < i + len; j++, j2++, wit++) {
                    double tmpR = aR[j2] * wR[wit] - aI[j2] * wI[wit];
                    double tmpI = aR[j2] * wI[wit] + aI[j2] * wR[wit];
                    aR[j2] = aR[j] - tmpR;
                    aI[j2] = aI[j] - tmpI;
                    aR[j] += tmpR;
                    aI[j] += tmpI;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inv) {
            for (int i = 0; i < local_n; i++) {
                aR[i] /= local_n;
                aI[i] /= local_n;
            }
        }
    }

    static vector<long long> multiply(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b, long long mod = MOD) {
        int na = a.size(), nb = b.size();
        int n = 1, k = 0;
        while (n < na + nb - 1) {
            n <<= 1;
            k++;
        }
        initialize(k);
        aR.resize(n);
        aI.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < na; ++i) aR[i] = a[i];
        for (int i = na; i < n; ++i) aR[i] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < nb; ++i) aI[i] = b[i];
        for (int i = nb; i < n; ++i) aI[i] = 0;
        fft(false, n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            double r = aR[i], i2 = aI[i];
            aR[i] = r * r - i2 * i2;
            aI[i] = 2 * r * i2;
        }
        fft(true, n);
        vector<long long> ret(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            long long val = (long long)(round(aR[i]));
            ret[i] = val % mod;
        }
        return ret;
    }
};

vector<double> FFT::wR, FFT::wI, FFT::rR, FFT::rI, FFT::aR, FFT::aI;
int FFT::n;
int FFT::k;
int FFT::lastk = -1;
vector<int> FFT::dp;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<long long> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        base[x] = 1;
    }
    auto res = FFT::multiply(base, base);
    long long tot = 0;
    // Since we want n >> 1 exponent, implement a recursive exponentiation with polynomial multiplication
    // As original Java code does recursion, we'll implement similar
    function<vector<long long>(vector<long long>, long long)> expo = [&](vector<long long> orig, long long pow) {
        if (pow == 1) return orig;
        if (pow & 1) {
            auto half = expo(orig, pow - 1);
            return FFT::multiply(orig, half);
        } else {
            auto half = expo(orig, pow >> 1);
            return FFT::multiply(half, half);
        }
    };
    vector<long long> res_poly = expo(base, n >> 1);
    for (auto e : res_poly) {
        tot = (tot + (e * e) % MOD) % MOD;
    }
    cout << tot << "\n";
    return 0;
}
